neighbours.label: the slot right before a reason or justification is named (give a ___, cited as the ___), predicting 'reason'
fire: Members can leave the club whenever they like, without needing to give a reason.
The landlord ended the lease and refused to offer a reason for his decision.
Police named heavy fog as the likely reason for the crash on the bridge.
Employees may decline the survey and do not have to state a reason.
The airline listed bad weather as the official reason for the delay.
You can return the shoes within thirty days without giving any explanation.
The coach pointed to injuries as the main cause of the team's poor season.
He quit the band suddenly and never provided a reason to the other members.
quiet: Members can leave the club whenever they like and come back next season.
The landlord ended the lease and offered a small refund to the tenants.
Police named the driver of the truck in a short statement on Monday.
Employees may decline the survey and fill it in at a later date.
The airline listed the new routes on its website last week.
You can return the shoes within thirty days if they still have the tags.
The coach pointed to the scoreboard and shouted at the referee.
He quit the band suddenly and gave a final concert for his fans.

predictions: 6/8 fire above 0.2, give-a-other-object near misses quiet
notes: Card peaks on ' a' / ' as' / ' the' before 'reason'; + pole suppresses ' reason', ' why' so the - pole promotes them.
